description: AngularJS directive for list of checkboxes, implementing checklist-model functionality with functions for contains, add, remove, and scope watching.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an array contains an item based on comparator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an item to an array if not already present.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from an array based on comparator.

methods.name: postLinkFn
methods.description: Link function that sets up watchers and model synchronization for the directive.

calls: comparator = function (a, b) { return a[comparatorExpression] === b[comparatorExpression]; }
